chunks: Ahmad narrated from Ali ibn al-Hakam from Saif ibn 'Amirah from Abu Bakr al-Hadrami who said:
I said to Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), 'What do you do on Friday?' He said, 'What do you do?' I said, 'I pray in my house, then I go out and pray with them.' He said, 'That is what I do as well.'
ai.seo_question: What is the recommended practice for Friday prayer according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: This narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* highlights the flexibility in Friday prayer practices during the era of Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him), where praying Dhuhr at home before joining the congregational prayer was a recognized and endorsed custom. It reflects the scholarly view that the noon prayer could be performed separately or combined with the Friday prayer, emphasizing the Imam's personal adherence to this method as a valid precedent for the community.
